purpose: A reviewable list of proposed changes to this project. Nothing here is implemented by having been written down. Each suggestion records why it would improve decision quality, what it would cost, what would falsify it, and what decision it is waiting on.
rules: A suggestion is a proposal, never a finding. Status starts at 'proposed'.
A suggestion may only be marked 'accepted' by a recorded decision in the Decision Brief.
No suggestion may add a numerical NFL claim. Suggestions that need numbers are blocked until a verified source exists.
A suggestion that cannot be tested has to say what would falsify it, or it is marked 'unfalsifiable' and rejected.

suggestions.title: Publish an explicit Decision Brief with named decisions and stopping rules
suggestions.problem: The site publishes research state but never states the decision it supports, who owns it, or what would make it stop. A reader cannot tell whether to act, wait, or abandon.
suggestions.proposal: Add a Decision Brief page listing each live decision, its owner, the evidence required, the current blocker, the default action if nothing changes, and the predeclared stopping rule.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Turns an open-ended research programme into a queue of decisions with a default. A missing fact becomes visible as a blocker instead of an unstated assumption.
suggestions.cost: One page and a JSON register; no new data source.
suggestions.falsified_by: A reader cannot act on the brief, or a decision changes after its stopping rule was declared.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Score each suggestion on decision impact before implementing anything
suggestions.problem: Suggestions arrive with unequal value and no shared ordering. The loudest idea wins by default.
suggestions.proposal: Give every suggestion four predeclared 1-3 scores: decision impact, evidence readiness (inverse), reversibility (inverse), and blocking others. Sort by impact times readiness.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Makes the ordering arguable on stated grounds instead of taste, and pushes evidence-blocked work to the back rather than letting it consume the schedule.
suggestions.cost: Scoring rubric and a sort; no data.
suggestions.falsified_by: The ordering produces a choice that the scoring explicitly said was worse.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Refuse to price any joint bet until a two-sided correlation interval clears a predeclared deadband
suggestions.problem: Multiplying marginal probabilities is the default in every parlay calculator. It silently asserts independence, which is the one assumption an NFL parlay most badly violates.
suggestions.proposal: Add engine.dependence_gate: a Fisher-z interval on the paired outcome with a deadband fixed before the test. Only a directionally clear verdict may enter a joint price; every other verdict returns no price at all.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Removes a fake number instead of replacing it with another fake number. A blank joint price is a true statement about what is known.
suggestions.cost: Implemented and unit-tested with synthetic data; no NFL value is claimed.
suggestions.falsified_by: A priced joint returns a probability outside the Frechet bounds, or an interval that straddles the deadband is used anyway.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Distinguish a changed starter from a depth-chart demotion, and leave the tier blank
suggestions.problem: The request asks for second, third and fourth string replacement tracking. No depth chart could be obtained from the league site (the club route returns a 404) and no string designation was found, so claiming one would be fabrication.
suggestions.proposal: Track the thing that is actually published: the eleven starters in each official Game Book. Diff consecutive weeks, list who left and who entered, and record cause and depth tier as null with an explicit 'not published' label.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: A verified change of starters is real signal. A guessed depth tier is noise that looks like signal, which is worse than missing.
suggestions.cost: Two Game Books per club-game; already done for one Week 9 to Week 10 pair.
suggestions.falsified_by: The NFL publishes a depth chart or string designation and the site keeps reporting the field as unavailable.
needs: A season-long Game Book archive to generalise beyond one club-game pair
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Publish the two official counterexamples that punish naive injury-report use
suggestions.problem: A blank injury designation looks like health, and a limited practice looks like doubt. Both readings were wrong in the same Week 10 game.
suggestions.proposal: Keep two concrete cases on the site: a player who did not practice and then started, and six of seven inactives who carried no injury designation at all.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Kills the two most common coding shortcuts before they reach a model. The evidence is official and re-checkable.
suggestions.cost: Already captured in the lineups evidence file.
suggestions.falsified_by: The cited players' official status lines are later corrected by the NFL.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Add a question, information and answer register with an explicit 'cannot be known yet' state
suggestions.problem: Missing information is scattered across the flags page, the data contract and the validation gates. There is no single list of what must be known before a decision is reasonable.
suggestions.proposal: Add one register with four columns: the question, the information needed, the answer if one is verified, and the dependency that blocks it. Every unanswerable question states why.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Converts an uncomfortable unknown into a work item. Also shows which unknowns are cheaply discoverable and which may be permanently unavailable.
suggestions.cost: One page and a JSON register.
suggestions.falsified_by: A question is marked answered without a linked official source.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Prefer a two-week verified availability diff over a league-wide injury feed
suggestions.problem: A live injury page is broad but shallow: it shows today's designation, not who actually started. Breadth without participation is not decision-useful.
suggestions.proposal: Where a choice exists, spend effort on Game Books, which contain the published starters, the inactive list and the final statistics for the same game.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Lets the project check whether a designation actually changed who played. That is the only version of availability that can be priced.
suggestions.cost: One PDF per game; manual or scripted extraction.
suggestions.falsified_by: Game Books turn out not to contain starters for the seasons being studied.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Publish a stated no-wager policy and a licence check before any price appears
suggestions.problem: The project discusses fair odds and expected return. Without a stated policy, a reader can mistake research algebra for a recommendation, and a jurisdiction question is never asked.
suggestions.proposal: Keep the no-live-wager notice, cite the regulator landing page for the operator's jurisdiction, and require an operator market-rules citation before any settlement state is used.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Separates 'this algebra is correct' from 'you may act on this here'. Prevents a legality problem being discovered after the fact.
suggestions.cost: Two citations already in the register.
suggestions.falsified_by: A row asserts settlement without an operator source, or a recommendation appears on the site.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Rank the leaderboard on a simultaneous lower bound, never on raw return
suggestions.problem: Ranking by return rewards variance. The best-looking strategy in a short sample is usually the luckiest, and multiplicity makes that worse.
suggestions.proposal: Rank only all-gate-pass candidates within a matched target, on the simultaneous lower confidence bound of log-loss improvement, with ties broken by Brier and then by lower frozen model complexity.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: A leaderboard that cannot be won by one hot week. Also makes an empty leaderboard an honest outcome rather than a broken page.
suggestions.cost: Policy plus already-tested scoring and interval code.
suggestions.falsified_by: A ranked entry fails a gate after publication, or ranking changes when the interval method changes.
needs: Real forecasts and executable quotes, which do not exist yet
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Require a power study before sealing any final test season
suggestions.problem: A sealed test with too few games cannot distinguish skill from noise, so passing it proves almost nothing and failing it proves nothing either.
suggestions.proposal: Block gate 3 until a minimum detectable effect and required sample size are written down for each candidate family.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Prevents the most expensive mistake in the programme: spending the one untouched season on a test that could not have answered the question.
suggestions.cost: Simulation work on synthetic data; no external data needed.
suggestions.falsified_by: The declared sample is met and the test result is still dominated by sampling error in the published interval.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Acquire a season-long official Game Book archive before any efficiency model
suggestions.problem: Two games cannot support any efficiency, pace or availability coefficient. One club-game pair can only demonstrate the extraction and the diff.
suggestions.proposal: Treat the archive as the entry ticket to modelling: full-season Game Books for the seasons in the training and sealed windows, keyed by stable game IDs.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Everything downstream is currently unfalsifiable. The archive is the single unblocking dependency.
suggestions.cost: Unknown, and the rights to redistribute raw PDFs are not established.
suggestions.falsified_by: A smaller verified dataset is shown to be sufficient for the declared effect size.
needs: An archive with clear redistribution rights
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Do not invent a closing line where no operator archive exists
suggestions.problem: Without executable historical prices, no economic gate can be evaluated. Reconstruction from news reports or memory would be fabrication.
suggestions.proposal: Keep every price field blank, state the acquisition requirement, and refuse to substitute a proxy. Consider a permissioned quote capture going forward rather than a back-filled history.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: A blank price column correctly says 'this question is unanswered'. A reconstructed one would corrupt every downstream number.
suggestions.cost: Zero now; ongoing capture has a real cost.
suggestions.falsified_by: A licensed historical quote source is obtained and prices can be cited per market.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Split the site's navigation into Decision, Evidence, Research and Review groups
suggestions.problem: Nine flat links put the Decision Brief next to the correlation lab. A reader who wants to know what to do has to read everything to find out.
suggestions.proposal: Group navigation by intent and add the new Decision Brief, Suggestions and Availability pages into those groups.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: A decision-maker reaches the decision page first. Structure encodes the project's own priorities.
suggestions.cost: Navigation markup and CSS only.
suggestions.falsified_by: Readers still cannot find the decision page, or grouping hides a page below the fold on mobile.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Model same-game prop dependence through shared exposures, not pairwise correlation
suggestions.problem: Pairwise correlations do not identify a joint distribution across three or more legs. A parlay of a quarterback, his receiver and the game total is exactly that case.
suggestions.proposal: Represent the game once as a shared scenario vector (plays, pass rate, target share, efficiency) and read every leg off the same draw, so joint dependence is structural rather than assumed.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Gives a joint distribution that is internally consistent by construction and cannot violate Frechet bounds.
suggestions.cost: Substantial modelling work; currently unimplemented.
suggestions.falsified_by: Held-out joint-event calibration of the simulated legs is worse than a directly estimated joint.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Track offensive-line combination continuity as a first-class availability feature
suggestions.problem: A quarterback change is visible in a box score. A line combination change is not, yet it plausibly moves pressure and sack rates more.
suggestions.proposal: From Game Book lineups, count consecutive starts per five-man combination and record combination changes as an explicit feature to be ablation-tested.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Tests a mechanistically motivated signal that most public analysis ignores, using data that is actually published.
suggestions.cost: Derivable once the archive exists.
suggestions.falsified_by: An ablation removing combination continuity does not change predictive quality.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Reject any proposal that cannot name what would falsify it
suggestions.problem: Unfalsifiable ideas survive indefinitely because no observation can retire them, and they crowd out testable work.
suggestions.proposal: Make a falsification statement a mandatory field. A suggestion without one cannot be accepted.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Keeps the register finite and the queue honest.
suggestions.cost: A required field enforced by the validator.
suggestions.falsified_by: An accepted suggestion is later found to have no possible disconfirming observation.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Acquire a permissioned, timestamped market-price archive
suggestions.problem: Every market_line and diff column in the price-snapshot store is blank because no official market price source exists; without quotes, ROI and closing-line value are uncomputable.
suggestions.proposal: Obtain a licensed archive of executable quotes with capture timestamps, market definitions and settlement rules; store raw captures under data/raw/ with provenance recorded in evidence/sources.json.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Turns the fair/market/difference design from blank columns into measurable ones, and makes ROI, CLV and the demotion gate's edge and CLV thresholds computable.
suggestions.cost: A paid or permissioned source plus retention terms; ingestion and provenance plumbing.
suggestions.falsified_by: A stored quote cannot be reproduced from the archive with its stated timestamp and rules, or the licence forbids the recorded use.
needs: a permissioned provider/operator archive with timestamps, market rules and documented reuse terms
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Operate the scheduled close-capture workflow for every originated market
suggestions.problem: Open snapshots exist for the 52 originated Week 10 markets, but a market without a recorded close cannot be graded, and closes captured by hand would violate the no-manual-input constraint.
suggestions.proposal: Run the committed scheduled workflow (pre-kickoff and daily) so tools/snapshot_close.py records model_fair and closed_at for each open snapshot before kickoff, failing closed on any input change.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Makes every future market gradeable without manual steps and timestamps the decision point the demotion gate and leaderboard need.
suggestions.cost: Scheduled CI minutes; commits restricted to data/snapshots/.
suggestions.falsified_by: A closed snapshot differs from what the recorded inputs produce under the recorded method id, or a close lands after kickoff.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Backtest signal scores on the verified results feed with a sealed design
suggestions.problem: The elo-v1 fair numbers are unvalidated in-sample outputs; the leaderboard signal score stays blank because no strategy has cleared the seven gates.
suggestions.proposal: Freeze a matched design (target markets, grading convention, folds, thresholds, family-wise correction) before evaluation, run it against the verified 2026 feed, and record every tried candidate.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Would give the signal column its first admissible numbers and decide whether elo-v1 deserves any place in origination; without it the fair column stays a labelled model artefact.
suggestions.cost: Design-freeze discipline and compute; risks discarding the current method.
suggestions.falsified_by: A backtest whose reported performance cannot be reproduced from the committed feed and design, or a design altered after seeing results.
needs: a frozen design document agreed before any evaluation run
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Adopt the signal/staking split for any future leaderboard competition
suggestions.problem: A single leaderboard column can conflate selection skill with money management; a lucky staking run would rank above a better signal.
suggestions.proposal: Adopt the published two-score design: rank and rewards follow the flat-stake signal score only; the staking score is published beside it and never blended in.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Keeps the competition measuring what it claims to measure and gives the demotion gate an unambiguous target to police.
suggestions.cost: None beyond keeping the two columns separate; slight loss of a single headline number.
suggestions.falsified_by: A ranking that changes when a staking plan changes while selections stay identical.
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

suggestions.title: Re-verify every results-feed row against its official game centre
suggestions.problem: The feed was transcribed from official weekly pages and passed structural cross-checks (weekly counts, bye arithmetic, 32 teams), but no independent per-game re-check has been performed.
suggestions.proposal: Before any ROI use, re-open each game’s official game centre and confirm the stored scores; record per-row verification state in the evidence file.
suggestions.why_it_improves_decisions: Upgrades the feed from structurally consistent to row-verified, which any graded bet or published correlation ultimately rests on.
suggestions.cost: One fetch per game (136 rows), scripted; a small per-week maintenance loop thereafter.
suggestions.falsified_by: Any game-centre score that disagrees with the stored row, or a row whose linked weekly page no longer shows the recorded result.
needs: per-game game-centre fetches recorded with their retrieval dates
suggestions.rank_note: Predeclared 1-3 scores: impact 3 = changes a live decision; evidence_cost 3 = needs data not held; reversibility_cost 3 = hard to undo.

scoring.impact: 1 = cosmetic, 2 = improves a page or process, 3 = changes a live decision or blocks one.
scoring.evidence_cost: 1 = already verified in the repo, 2 = needs one more official artefact, 3 = needs an archive or licence not held.
scoring.reversibility_cost: 1 = trivially undone, 2 = needs a coordinated edit, 3 = irreversible once published or once a season is opened.
scoring.order: Ascending (impact negated), then evidence_cost, then reversibility_cost. Implemented items are listed first regardless of score because they are done.
